stem: How do the bottom-dwelling fish in Shark Bay cause a problem for the dolphins?

options.label: A
options.text: The fish swim so quickly the dolphins are unable to catch them.

options.label: B
options.text: The fish are not nutritious enough to support the health of the dolphins.

options.label: C
options.text: The fish travel to other locations during certain times of the year.

options.label: D
options.text: The fish do not have a certain body part that allows the dolphins to locate them.
